name: Project experience sheet
summary: For one finished project and one proposal, turn the firm's approved project records into a one-page experience sheet: the firm's role, the scope it performed, partners' work kept apart, and the record behind each line. Names, images and permissions still to confirm are listed for sign-off.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of the work of preparing a project experience sheet for an engineering firm's proposal: a register of statements with their source records and who performed the work, a register of permissions, the firm's work kept apart from partners' work, design performance and unsupported results left out, and every name, image and claim held for a person's approval.
